summary: Iter 105 verifies the new `caption` param on the merchant QR poster endpoint plus the Expo-web Scan-QR flow that embeds the caption into the poster when the share sheet can't carry image+caption. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases green — PNG w/o caption = 1080x1350; PNG with multiline caption (containing an https link) = 1080x >1350 (caption strip appended); PDF with caption = 200 application/pdf; emoji-only caption safely collapses back to 1080x1350 (emoji stripped server-side, no crash); caption with emoji+text + long-link produces height >1350; 900+ char caption → 200 (server truncates to 600). Frontend (Expo web via Metro tunnel https://bpo56qm-anonymous-8081.exp.direct, demo-merchant login → /merchant/scanqr): hero-whatsapp fires GET /api/merchant/panel/qr/poster?fmt=png with a NON-EMPTY caption= param (294 chars, contains full waMsg + booking link) and opens api.whatsapp.com/send popup; hero-share (canShare unavailable in headless) opens share-modal AND fires poster fmt=png with a NON-EMPTY caption= (shareMessage). dl-png and dl-pdf both send caption= EMPTY (plain poster). No red-box overlay, zero console errors.

cosmetic.issue: Waving-hand emoji \u{1F44B} in defaultWaMsg is transmitted as U+FFFD (%EF%BF%BD) in the wa.me/send popup URL. Pre-existing (documented in iteration_104), not a regression from this change. Booking link + rest of caption arrive intact. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: qr_poster_service.build_svg: height correctly derived from caption strip (total_h = H + strip_h) and rendered by render() via regex — clean and safe for pdf too.
_strip_emoji + _caption_lines properly handle multi-line captions incl. https link paragraphs (bold link line) and truncate to 14 lines; safe from renderer crashes.
route: caption[:600] server-side truncation is defensive — matches spec.

posterActions.canShareWithCaption() returns !!navigator.canShare on web — in headless (no canShare) the caption is embedded via the caption= query param. Verified empirically that both hero-share and hero-whatsapp send NON-EMPTY caption while dl-png/dl-pdf send caption= EMPTY, exactly as spec'd.
shareWith() correctly passes `captionEmbedded: embed` down to sharePosterFile so the two-step share on native Expo Go is skipped when caption already lives in the image.
